caption: The BulkCertPDF web tool before generating: the header with the counter Free, 25 of 25 left this month and the Upgrade $19 button, the recipient table with 5 rows (Test Person One to Four and a very long fictional name in row 5), the merge tags {{Full_Name}}, {{Course_Title}} and {{Completion_Date}}, the Official CPD design selected, and the certificate preview in which the 86-character name runs to the edge of the paper and touches the inner border at both sides without being made smaller. The text on the certificate still shows the raw tags {{CPD_Hours}} and {{Certificate_Ref}}. The sample signature box was covered by a dark block by the tester before the screenshot was saved.

The same tool after one batch of 5 certificates was generated: the counter now says Free, 20 of 25 left this month, the bottom of the certificate preview shows the raw {{Certificate_Ref}} tag and the small line Made with BulkCertPDF, the button Generate All 5 PDFs (.ZIP) Free is visible, and a box asks whether you want certificate templates and wording ideas by email (left empty). The ZIP itself was not opened. The sample signature box is covered by a dark block.

The Simple pricing section of the page: Free at $0 (Upload Excel or CSV, All 8 designs, logo and signatures, 25 certificates a month, Small Made with BulkCertPDF line, no watermark), Batch Pass at $19 one-off (up to 500 certificates, no watermark or branding, 7 days of access, no subscription) and Pro at $29 a month or $199 a year (unlimited certificates, no watermark or branding, cancel anytime), the Lemon Squeezy checkout line, the 14-day money-back guarantee and a support address of the vendor (covered). No account detail is on this screen; none of the buy buttons was clicked.
